item.title: Linux Version Support for Trae AI
item.body:
🚀 Feature Request: Linux Version Support

👋 Hey Trae AI team,

I'm Rakibul, an AI & Python developer and a huge fan of Trae AI Editor! 💻
I've been using your AI-powered IDE for coding and debugging, and it has significantly enhanced my productivity with its intelligent code generation, refactoring, and auto-completion capabilities.

However, Trae AI currently lacks official support for Linux, which is a major limitation for me and many other developers.

🔥 Why Linux Support Matters:
Growing Linux Community:

A large portion of the developer community uses Linux for programming, server management, and development environments.
Native Linux support will expand your user base significantly.
Performance and Stability:

Running Trae AI on Linux natively (without Wine) will provide better performance, stability, and resource efficiency.
Linux users often prioritize lightweight, efficient IDEs, making Trae AI a perfect fit.
Demand from Developers:

Many Linux users are actively requesting support.
A native Linux build would make Trae more accessible and widely adopted.

🛠️ Potential Benefits:
SSH Remote Support → Easier remote server management.
CLI Mode → Faster performance on Linux terminals.
Low-RAM Compatibility → Better performance on low-memory machines.

✅ Request Details:
Target Platforms: Ubuntu, Debian, Fedora, Arch.
Packaging Formats: .deb, .AppImage, .tar.gz for easier installation.
Optional CLI Mode: Ability to run in terminal mode for low-resource usage.

🌟 Conclusion:
As a 18-year-old AI developer working on large-scale projects, Linux support would significantly improve my workflow.
I genuinely believe Trae AI on Linux would benefit a massive developer community.

✨ Thank you for creating such an amazing product, and I hope you'll consider adding Linux support soon! 🚀

Best regards,
Rakibul Islam
